Not a very strong hook, I think " According to World Health Organization more than 700.000 lives were lost through
suicide globally in 2019, making it the fourth leading cause of death among 15 - 29 year olds [2]" is a much stronger hook.

This section lacks helpful citations to back up claims such as:
- "Generative AI has demonstrated its potential to support mental health research by identifying language
patterns in social media posts and electronic health records" 
and
- "However, studies indicate that AI systems underperform in identifying
Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) compared to other conditions"
suggestion: ".. further research has to be done  .."
It would further strengthen your study if you cited previous studies that have done something similar or in this area and how you differ from them/ what youve learnt from their studies

Strong section, great job!
Your mentioned theories are relevant to your research
This is good but also mention risks associated with this such as, what if youre unable to find such patient reports? Do these patients consent to their information being accessed in this way?
Could cite more studies here as well for the same reasons mentioned in SOTA

You must already have some preliminary idea of how you want to answer your research questions. This statement leads me to believe that youre still on the search for that.
If you mentioned a rough idea, your methodology section can try to answer your proposed research questions instead of leaving the reader to guess what youre doing to fulfill them
This is vague, what are you annotating and organizing and why does it require a week that is separate from your literature research?
This 'framework' is not elaborated on anywhere else, so this leaves me confused on what this means
this should already have been decided on, or atleast done much earlier

Start writing early, as soon as you can. This allows you to not forget/look past all the relevant steps youve made to meet your goals. 
While researching, you can write a draft for the corresponding sections to what youre currently doing
You can have someone uninvolved with your project proofread your report. This way, they can tell you if your narrative is convincing enough and if not, why
